def add_no_short_cycle_constraints(solver, length):
    count = 0
    # Generate all possible part sequences
    for pseq in product(range(3), repeat=length):
        if len(set(pseq)) < 2: continue
        # check consecutive different including last to first
        if any(pseq[i] == pseq[(i+1) % length] for i in range(length)):
            continue
        # count verts per part
        cnts = [pseq.count(k) for k in range(3)]
        if max(cnts) > len(parts[0]): continue  # rough
        # positions per part
        pos_p = [[] for _ in range(3)]
        for idx, p in enumerate(pseq):
            pos_p[p].append(idx)
        # now combinations for verts
        combs_iter = product(*[combinations(parts[k], len(pos_p[k])) for k in range(3)])
        for combs in combs_iter:
            vert = [0] * length
            for k in range(3):
                for ii, pos in enumerate(pos_p[k]):
                    vert[pos] = combs[k][ii]
            # check all verts distinct: since from diff parts or same part but comb distinct, yes always distinct.
            # now create the cycle edges
            cycle_edges = []
            for i in range(length):
                u,vv = vert[i], vert[(i+1)%length]
                ee = (min(u,vv), max(u,vv))
                cycle_edges.append(edge_var[ee])
            # add constraint
            solver.add(Or([Not(ee) for ee in cycle_edges]))
            count += 1
            if count > 100000 and length == 6:  # to prevent too many, but will see
                return count  # if too much
    return count
